g.text: V16 | Actual WBC controller and physical loop
Whole-body QP job 577. Control update 20 ms; PhysX and emergency motor envelope 5 ms. All paths below are used by the runtime.
next 20 ms: measured state and contact return to reference, dynamics oracle and WBC
Gait/IK builds q_r; the dashed model path supplies h. QP and torque reconstruction share M, h, J. Predicted force differs from physical contact.
